photos.name: New_Wing_On_Mansion_(Shanghai).jpg
photos.author: Legolas1024
observed_features: New Wing On tower and high podium, cream/yellow-brown face brick and broad pale parapet bands.
Upper tower has narrow inset shoulders and a smaller pale top enclosure; low viewpoint prevents exact terrace dimensions.
Large commercial panels cover lower floor openings in this 2011 photo; these cannot establish present-day facade.
Dark enclosed street bridge visible on right is separate from primary building scope.

photos.name: Wing_On_Department_Store_(Shanghai)_20250501-1.jpg
photos.author: Suicasmo
observed_features: Daylight principal broad elevation: high podium under upper tower, a substantially lower adjoining long wing to image left with a rounded outer end.
Tower central window bands, recessed narrow side strips, pale horizontal top cornices and small terminal crown enclosure are visible.
A large thermometer assembly runs down central high-podium face, with rooftop hotel sign above.
Trees obstruct most ground-level openings and an advertising panel covers upper low-wing windows; do not invent concealed details.
Photo alone does not prove the complete historical ownership/extent of the long lower wing.

Commercial signage differs from 2024; geometry should not claim one fully reconstructed operating state.

scope: 新永安／七重天北部前塔、高基座与楔形后低翼；老永安、跨街桥、室内和邻楼不并入。

documented_constraints.design_policy: 72米选为模型建筑实体顶部的设计约束；分层、塔肩退距、宽深和背面均为估计。模型采用地图支持的楔形范围，不从文献面积反推实测边长。

period_policy: 以2011、2013、2024及2025实看照片中共通外观为参照，主参照为2025-05-01两张；不宣称复原1932/1933/1936开业状态或精确2026现状。
address_and_date_policy: 采用现址627号；727门牌与1932／1933／1936年代不同来源记载保留，不擅自裁定历史阶段。
design_policy: 主体楔形外包、北端三窗窄面、东北温度计面、矩形退台塔、削角顶冠、宽白檐与浅黄棕面砖为参考形态。逐层高度、退距、隐面、窗格密度、低翼圆角和后部范围仍估计。72米选为建筑实体顶，现代细杆不包含。
placement_policy: 按已识别源对象近似定位；地图覆盖范围不是测绘墙线。主图俯瞰，不新增室内或自由漫游验收。
copyright: 原创几何与代码；照片和文章权利各归原作者/机构，公开的许可/URL/SHA只用于出处核验。未复制第三方照片像素、正文或商标贴图。
